title: Gated Payoff-Weighted Net Profit Maximization For Online Portfolio Selection With Transaction Costs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we study online portfolio selection (OLPS) problems. The net profit maximization (NPM) acting upon Adaptive Online Moving Average (AOLMA), namely the AOLNPM strategy in portfolio selection, trades when forecast gain exceeds the transaction cost. In essence, this method relies heavily on calibrated forecasts. Indeed, we show that AOLMA forecasts overstate the realized relative returns. We therefore design a gate that adjusts how strongly an AOLMA forecast is used; for each asset, it learns the recent mixture proportion assigned to AOLMA from predictive likelihoods against a neutral forecast (no change). The proportion therefore estimates the extent to which the forecast is realized. We then feed the resulting forecast into the NPM portfolio rule, where the gate acts as an asset-specific cost threshold. A payoff-weighted fund combines gated NPM experts with fixed decay factors in proportion to their wealth and needs no learn

translated_title: 面向含交易成本的在线投资组合选择的门控收益加权净利润最大化
translated_abstract: 本文研究在线投资组合选择（OLPS）问题。将净利润最大化（NPM）作用于自适应在线移动平均（AOLMA）的策略，即投资组合选择中的AOLNPM策略，在预测收益超过交易成本时进行交易。从本质上讲，该方法严重依赖于经过校准的预测。事实上，我们证明AOLMA预测会高估实际实现的相对收益。因此，我们设计了一个门控机制来调整AOLMA预测的使用强度；对于每种资产，它通过与中性预测（即不变）对比的预测似然，学习近期分配给AOLMA的混合比例。因此，该比例可以估计预测被实现的程度。随后，我们将由此产生的预测输入到NPM投资组合规则中，其中门控充当针对特定资产的成本阈值。收益加权基金按固定衰减因子以其财富比例组合多个门控NPM专家，且无需学习……
tldr: 针对AOLMA预测高估实际收益的问题，本文提出一种门控机制来估计预测被实现的程度，并将其作为资产特定的成本阈值应用于净利润最大化规则，再通过收益加权基金组合多个门控NPM专家，从而在存在交易成本的条件下实现更可靠的在线投资组合选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a gating mechanism that estimates the realized proportion of AOLMA forecasts and acts as an asset-specific cost threshold in the net profit maximization rule, combined with a payoff-weighted fund of gated NPM experts, enabling more reliable online portfolio selection under transaction costs.
